# discord_bulk_delete_messages (Action)

Deletes between 2 and 100 messages from a channel in one request. Discord refuses the whole request if any message is more than two weeks old, so the action checks the age each message ID encodes before sending it. IDs of messages that no longer exist still count toward the limits. Requires the Manage Messages permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run with: terraform apply -invoke=action.discord_bulk_delete_messages.spam
action "discord_bulk_delete_messages" "spam" {
  config {
    channel_id       = discord_text_channel.general.id
    message_ids      = ["345678901234567890", "345678901234567891"]
    audit_log_reason = "Spam"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel the messages are in.
- `message_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the messages to delete, between 2 and 100, each less than two weeks old.

### Optional

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for this action, overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters.
